svg.title: Babul points from a dry low lane to axle-high water marks near the canal.
svg.desc: The lane slopes towards the old canal and a blocked outflow. Faded stains on the wall show previous water above axle height while Riju's map depicts a permanent straight road.
svg.text: Page 40, panel 2 · Ground-level view along the lane towards the old canal

text.tspan: Babul shows how rising canal water occupies the lane
even when the surface currently appears passable.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
